## Close Deals Faster with CPQ

Legacy CPQ tools burden sales teams with manual data entry, creating friction that kills deals and momentum. While your reps struggle with complex systems, opportunities go cold and competitors move in.

HubSpot's CPQ transforms quoting from bottleneck to breakthrough. The streamlined editor automatically drafts personalized quotes using deal context, so your team spends time closing, not composing.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What is CPQ software?

CPQ (or Configure, Price, Quote) software, helps sales reps manage complex product configurations, set accurate pricing, and generate professional quotes faster.

HubSpot's CPQ pulls data directly from your CRM deal record to build branded quotes in minutes, with built-in approvals, e-signature, and payment collection — all in one platform.

### How does HubSpot CPQ collect payment?

HubSpot quotes include built-in payment collection, so buyers can pay directly from the quote. Use HubSpot payments or connect your existing Stripe account, all without leaving HubSpot.

### What’s the difference between CPQ and quoting?

Quoting, the tools reps use to build and send quotes to prospects, is part of the CPQ process. Solid quoting tools are the foundation of CPQ, which also has configuration tools, pricing tools, and integrated deal tracking.

### Do HubSpot’s CPQ tools require training?

No. HubSpot CPQ tools are not only powerful, they’re easy to use, so your sales team can be up and running in no time.

Built atop the [HubSpot Smart CRM](/products/crm/ai-crm) platform, HubSpot’s quote tools seamlessly pull customer data from your deals, reducing the need for copious data entry and the risk of mistakes.

### How does CPQ work with Sales Hub?

Sales teams get the most value when they use Sales Hub with a Revenue Hub seat—which unlocks CPQ functionality.

Sales Hub is an easy-to-use software that helps teams build pipelines and close deals. CPQ, part of Revenue Hub, speeds up quoting with CPQ. Together, the two tools help sales teams close deals faster.
